dossier.scp_unleashed.002.title: The Living Room
dossier.scp_unleashed.002.caption: SCP-002 in situ, before removal of the meteoric crust.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-002 is to remain where it came to rest. A perimeter of no less than 30 m is to be marked, lit and kept clear of unescorted personnel.
**Under no circumstances is the entrance of SCP-002 to be opened.** Observation is to be carried out from beyond the perimeter.
The meteoric crust may be sampled with standard tools. The tissue beneath it has resisted cutting, burning and explosives, and further attempts are discouraged.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-002 is a rounded mass of living tissue roughly 13 m across, sheathed in a crust of dark meteoric stone. It arrives from deep space as a meteorite and comes to rest half-buried at the centre of its own impact crater.

The tissue encloses a single furnished room, reached through a riveted iron bulkhead door set into the flesh of its outer face. The room holds a bed, a desk and chair, a lamp, a rug and a dresser, each formed from flesh and bone.
The door opens readily from outside and seals behind anyone who enters. Its inner face has no handle, and it cannot be opened from within.
Subjects describe the room as warm, quiet and oddly comfortable. After an interval of %runder a minute%r the walls begin to move. No subject has survived, and no remains have been recovered.

page.title: Addendum 002-1: Furnishings
page.text: Every survey lists the same six pieces of furniture in the same places. The room does not grow and it does not redecorate. Whatever it does with those it keeps, it does not add them to the furniture.

block.scp_unleashed.scp002_shell.tooltip: Dark stone crust from a meteorite.
block.scp_unleashed.scp002_shell.details: Chipped from the outer shell of SCP-002.
block.scp_unleashed.scp002_door.sealed: The bulkhead will not move from this side.
block.scp_unleashed.scp002_bed.touch: The sheets are warm. They rise and fall.
block.scp_unleashed.scp002_desk.touch: The drawer is sealed shut with skin.
block.scp_unleashed.scp002_chair.touch: The seat gives under your hand, like a held breath.
block.scp_unleashed.scp002_dresser.touch: Something behind the drawers is listening.
block.scp_unleashed.scp002_lamp.touch: The shade is stretched thin. It glows from within.
block.scp_unleashed.scp002_rug.touch: The hide is soft, and still warm.
item.scp_unleashed.scp002_specimen.toolt: A sliver of meteoric crust. Something soft moves inside.

item.scp_unleashed.scp002_specimen.strik: Sneak and right-click to call its meteor down on that spot
item.scp_unleashed.scp002_specimen.calle: Something is falling toward that spot.
scp002.scp_unleashed.lead.falling: A light is falling across the sky.
scp002.scp_unleashed.consume.no_escape: The room holds you in place.
